I've actually wanted veneers for a long time because my teeth are yellow, and whitening only makes them yellow again quickly. My teeth aren't very aesthetically pleasing, but there were so many clinics to choose from. After much deliberation, I finally decided on this clinic. From seeing many of the doctor's cases, their analysis and solutions were the most effective. When I met the doctor in person, she addressed my long-standing concerns about my crooked teeth and my incomplete smile. She analyzed my situation without me having to say much, and it was exactly as I thought. The results are beautiful and seamless, just like my natural teeth. No one around me knows I have veneers unless I tell them, because they look so natural. The doctor even taught me how to smile to complement my new teeth. I feel much happier with my new smile and am more confident smiling now. Another thing I appreciated was that the doctor didn't just focus on aesthetics but also prioritized dental health, such as bite alignment. She checked and adjusted my bite multiple times to ensure it was perfectly aligned and taught me how to use dental floss more effectively. If you're considering veneers, I highly recommend this clinic.
